'''Chief Researcher''' was a position within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maxina Sensis]] held the title of Chief Researcher while assigned to the [[Daxis Outpost]] in the [[Jandolhoon system/Legends|Jandolhoon system]].
